description:
Create an invitation link for one email address, the same as Share in the app. Poacher emails no one: give the person the invitation_url and they send it themselves. Only that email address can accept, within 7 days. The recipient sees new results on channels they confirm; the owner keeps paying and the recipient cannot see the criteria, billing or settings. Read the email address back to the person and get their agreement before calling.

Permission: alerts:write.

email.description: The email address of the person to invite, exactly as the person gave it.

name: share_alert

invitation_url.description: Give this to the person; Poacher sends nothing. Works once, only for that email address, for 7 days.

title: Share an alert with someone
